title: Trade Day

serves.summary: The child trades goods between neighbours (drag one good onto another to swap them) until every neighbour has the thing they need, including needs that go around a ring of three and a neighbour with nothing to trade who is given a share, which shows how trading and sharing let people get what they need.

request.topic: Trading goods so everyone has what they need
request.objective: Neighbours each have extra of one thing and need another: trade goods between them, in more than one step when needs go around a ring, so every neighbour ends with what they need, and share with a neighbour who has nothing to trade. (SS002-03-A, SS002-01-I, SS002-03-I, SS002-03-C)

params.story: Ana baked bread but has no milk. Ben has milk but no bread.

problems.ask: Ana and Ben each need something. Help them both get what they need.
problems.goal: Ana holds milk and Ben holds bread: one swap.

params.story: Three neighbours. Ana has bread and apples and needs milk. Ben has milk and needs eggs. Cal has eggs and needs bread.

problems.ask: Ana, Ben and Cal each need something. Help all three get what they need.
problems.goal: Ana holds milk, Ben holds eggs, Cal holds bread. The needs go around a ring, so one trade is never enough: the bread has to pass through Ben.

params.story: A farmer grew wheat and needs bread. A baker has bread and needs wheat to bake more. A fisher caught fish and needs bread.

problems.ask: The farmer, the baker and the fisher each need something. Help all three get what they need.
problems.goal: The farmer and the fisher each hold bread and the baker holds wheat. Both bread trades are with the baker; a fish-for-wheat trade with the farmer leaves the fisher without bread.

params.story: Ana made two pots of soup and needs bread. Ben has bread and needs soup. Grandpa has nothing to trade and needs soup.

problems.ask: Ana, Ben and Grandpa each need something. Grandpa has nothing to trade. Help all three get what they need.
problems.goal: Ana holds bread, Ben holds soup and Grandpa holds soup: one trade and one share. Giving both soups to Grandpa leaves Ana and Ben without.
